                              Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                           SUBSTITUTE            ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-1 in the
area bound by:

      South Kedzie Avenue; a line 246.74 feet south of and parallel to West 19"' Street; the
      alley next east of and parallel to South Kedzie Avenue; and a line 296.74 feet south of
      and parallel to West 19"' Street,

to those of a B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2.Thisordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          Michael Scott Jr.
                                                          Alderman, 24'" Ward

1925-1929 S. Kedzie Avenue
